entities.name: Brushwagg
entities.description: A creature that looks like a heap of animated kindling, found on Dominaria, Ikoria and Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Mtenda Plains
entities.description: Plains in Jamuraa near which large brushwaggs live.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: A region of Dominaria containing the Mtenda Plains.

entities.name: Fola
entities.description: Recipient of a message scrawled by a brushwagg.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: A plane where small hedgehog-like brushwaggs are found.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: A plane where brushwaggs masquerade as tumbleweed.

relations.note: Large brushwaggs live near the plains.
relations.quote: The brushwaggs near the Mtenda Plains in Jamuraa are large animals

relations.note: A brushwagg sent a message to Fola; they are employed as messengers.
relations.quote: brushwaggs are happily employed by humans as messengers
